summary: Frontend testing for Add Income navigation redirects and Other Income scroll fix. 8/9 features verified working. Main issues: 1) Other Income form scroll to top NOT working (scroll position 381 on load instead of 0).

ui_bugs.issue: Page does NOT scroll to top on load - scroll position is 381 instead of 0. Root cause: useEffect at line 105-111 scrolls to conditionalRef after mount when formData.frequency has initial value 'One-Time'

issues: Console shows HTML hydration warnings about <span> inside <option> and <select> - non-critical React dev warnings from Emergent Visual Editor

action_items: Fix OtherIncomeForm.js scroll to top - the useEffect at lines 105-111 that scrolls to conditionalRef is running on initial load when formData.frequency has default value 'One-Time'. Add a flag to skip initial scroll or check if frequency actually changed from user action.
critical_code_review_comments: OtherIncomeForm.js line 105-111: The scroll-to-conditional-field effect runs on mount because formData.frequency is initialized to 'One-Time'. This causes the page to scroll down on load, defeating the window.scrollTo(0,0) at line 96-97.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Add Income navigation redirects verified working. OtherIncomeForm scroll to top issue needs fix in lines 105-111 - add initial mount check to prevent scrollIntoView on initial render.
